headline: Democratic Republic of Congo Suspends Cobalt Exports to Support Global Prices
summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo announced it will suspend cobalt exports starting at the end of the month in an effort to curb oversupply and boost global spot prices.
why: The DRC produces over 70% of the world's cobalt, an essential raw material for electric vehicle batteries.

impacts.name: Cobalt
impacts.why: The DRC's export ban reduces global cobalt supply, putting upward pressure on prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The DRC's decision to halt exports threatens global supply, sparking price gains in cobalt markets.
